verdict.rationale: uv.lock is documented as a well-defined, cross-platform lockfile containing exact dependency information, and uv provides a documented CLI/reference and llms.txt for machine consumption, supporting agent readability. However, the evidence never explicitly states the lockfile's text format (TOML) or its diff-friendliness, nor is there community/hands-on confirmation of agents reading/diffing uv.lock. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the lockfile's text/TOML format, explicit diff-friendliness claims, and independent evidence of agents successfully parsing or diffing uv.lock.
